### Sign up Tailscale

https://login.tailscale.com/

---

### Add Device

https://login.tailscale.com/admin/

點右上角的 "Add device"
![image](data:image/png;base64,)

選 "Linux Server"
![image](data:image/png;base64,)

---

### Add Linux Server

在這個頁面，設定好之後，點 "Generate install script"
然後去Linux Server內執行

![image](data:image/png;base64,)

---

### Finally

回到 https://login.tailscale.com/admin/
應該就能看到你的machine，還有address.


### Tailscale Client

Client安裝:
https://tailscale.com/download

#### Windows

軟體內，找到你要連線的device，用address連線即可。
![image](data:image/png;base64,)
